youtube.title: At 2:14 AM, the Ground Under Lot 9 Knocked Back
youtube.description:
An original animated horror short. Night-shift worker Milo knocks on his hard hat for luck: two quick, one slow. Tonight, something under the construction site answers in the same rhythm. Who is knocking? Watch to the last knock.

This story is fiction. All characters and places are invented.
